svg.aria-label: Pen-and-ink map drawing of Qeshm Island lying along the Iranian coast at the Strait of Hormuz, with the Khuran strait between, mangrove channels in the western bay, the islets of Hengam and Larak, and folded ridges on the mainland
svg.desc: Sketched from a satellite image on Al Jazeera: Qeshm Island off Iran, where explosions were reported late Monday.
